label: Objects
summary: Dynamic objects, properties, built-in classes, and member-access conventions.
must_follow: Reserve property for dynamic-object members, SSLExpando members, and AddProperty-created members.
Use field for :DECLARE slots on classes.
Instantiate directly creatable built-in classes with curly braces, for example Email{}.
Use no spaces around member access colon.
avoid: Do not use CreateUdObject for built-in class instances.
Do not blur class fields and dynamic object properties in documentation or reviews.

elements.name: CreateUdObject
elements.summary: Creates a dynamic object or instantiates a user-defined class.

elements.name: AddProperty
elements.summary: Adds one or more properties to an object.

elements.name: SSLExpando
elements.summary: SSLExpando is a built-in object class for storing named values whose shape is decided at runtime.

elements.name: Email
elements.summary: Composes, loads, saves, sends, or queues email messages with attachments and optional signing or encryption.

elements.name: SQLConnection
elements.summary: Represents a configured database connection returned by GetConnectionByName.

elements.name: me
elements.summary: Provides a reference to the current class instance inside :CLASS methods.

elements.name: base
elements.summary: Provides explicit access to members on a class's immediate parent type from within a class method.
